title: Code for construction and maintenance of surface farm drainage systems
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the recommended practice for construction and maintenance of surface farm drainage systems.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Code for design of surface farm drainage system

clause_3_terminology: Code for construction and maintenance of surface farm drainage systems

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
